UNDERTAKING 
 
 I, Mark Nosworthy s/o Stephen Charles Nosworthy having Passport No. PE0410394 in my capacity as authorized representative of M/S EMPG Holdings Limited do hereby solemnly declare that the said company has subscribed as shareholder in M/ S Zameen Developments (Private) Limited and has submitted necessary documents with the Company Registration Office (CRO) , Securit ies and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) , Lahore for its registration . In case M/S EMPG Holdings Limited is not security cleared by the Ministry of Interior (MOI), M/S EMPG Holdings Limited shall take immediate steps for its replacement as shareholder and shall transfer its shares to other person ( s ) and /or other company, and shall file revised doc uments accordingly with the CRO forthwith.
